user.title: Add a phone
user.description: The phone sends to the address below. It is filled in with the one your browser is using right now. Change it if the phone should use another one: your home network address to sync at home only, or your public address to sync from anywhere.

data_description.name: Becomes the device name. Worth setting with more than one phone in the house.
data_description.base_url: Just the address, without /api/webhook. You can change it later without pairing again.
data_description.use_cloud: Creates a cloudhook, so the phone syncs from anywhere without port forwarding. The address above is then not used.

reconfigure.title: Life Dashboard
reconfigure.description:
{qr}

Scan this with your phone's camera, or with the camera button in the app. Or paste by hand:

Webhook URL:
`{webhook_url}`

Signing secret:
`{secret}`

Paste both into the Webhook card on the Health tab and on the Screen Time tab of the app.

data_description.use_cloud: Creates a cloudhook, so the phone syncs from anywhere without port forwarding. The address above is then not used.
data_description.regenerate_secret: The phone stops syncing until you paste the new secret into both tabs.

error.invalid_url: That is not a full address. It needs the scheme and the host, the way the address bar of your browser shows it: http or https, then the name or IP address, and the port if there is one.
error.cloud_not_connected: Home Assistant Cloud is not connected.

abort.already_configured: This phone is already set up.

create_entry.default:
{qr}

Scan this with your phone's camera, or with the camera button in the app. Or paste by hand:

URL:
`{webhook_url}`

HMAC signing secret:
`{secret}`

Open the app, go to the Health tab, Webhook card, and paste both. Do the same on the Screen Time tab, then tap Test and Sync now. Sensors appear as soon as the first data arrives.

If the phone cannot reach that URL, open this integration's Reconfigure, change the address, and you get a new code.
